# netbox_fhrp_group_assignment (Resource)

Manages a NetBox FHRP group assignment (`/api/ipam/fhrp-group-assignments/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_fhrp_group_assignment" "example" {
  group_id = netbox_fhrp_group.example.id
  interface_type = "example"
  interface_id = 1
  priority = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Fhrp Group (`netbox_fhrp_group`).
- `interface_id` (Number) Interface Id.
- `interface_type` (String) Interface Type.
- `priority` (Number) Priority.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
